items.title: Dolly Douroux Adams Interview, 1962-04-18
items.q: INTERVIEWEE: Well, um... You say he's dead. ... INTERVIEWER: He's one of the most famous clarinets. Professor Renetta talks a lot about him. He was a close friend of his. ... INTERVIEWEE: Yes, about that.

ctx.x: Well, after you get to that age, you know, your memory began to lax on you.

So that's interesting. You work with, uh... They call him Louis DeLeo is his real name, but everybody called him Louis Nelson. His name really wasn't... His father's name wasn't Nelson, but I think his father once had worked for some people for the name of Nelson. Somehow that name got started. And then they called him Big I. He didn't like that nickname, but his Louis DeLeo was his real name. Oh, yeah. He lived right here in the neighborhood not far down on the Durban Street near St. Bernard Circle.
Well, um... You say he's dead.
